artworks.title: Death of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a biblical scene. The artwork depicts several haloed figures, potentially saints or apostles, surrounding a central reclining figure also wearing a halo. The figure holding a lit candle. The composition is densely populated, with strong linear elements suggesting a woodcut style. Above, there is a divine assembly in the clouds with celestial beings and possibly a deity observing. The background shows an architectural setting with large grid-like windows.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of England
artworks.description: The image shows a woman depicted from the waist up. She is seated and faces slightly towards her left. Her face is oval-shaped with prominent cheekbones and a slightly pointed chin. Her hair is styled with tight curls, adorned with a crown and decorative elements. Her clothing is detailed, featuring an ornate dress with intricate patterns and a wide, pleated ruff collar. She holds a scepter in her right hand and an orb in her left, and wears a bracelet on her left wrist. The background is plain with a coat of arms displayed in the upper right corner, and the image is further embellished with Latin text and decorative borders.

artworks.title: Elizabeth, Queen of England
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 34.8 x 22.8 cm (13 11/16 x 9 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a regal woman standing. She has a composed expression with high forehead and distinct eyebrows. She has elaborate hair styling with curls and a crown-like accessory. She wears an opulent gown with intricate patterns, detailed sleeves, an ornate collar, and accessories including pearls, an orb, and a scepter. In the background, there is a sword, a table with items, and a coat of arms above her, along with ornate drapery.

artworks.title: Cabaret of Ramponaux
artworks.artist: French 18th Century (formerly attributed to Benoît-Louis Prévost)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an 18th-century tavern interior. The large room is filled with tables and benches, with groups enjoying food and drink. Above them on the wall, there are childish sketches and writing. To the right, there is a large fireplace with kitchen utensils hanging above. A group of individuals is gathered around a serving table, while others are engaged in an activity in a corner. The lower section features an ornate medallion with the profile of a man wearing a hat, labeled "Jean Ramponaux," surrounded by French text.

artworks.title: Study for "Le Stryge"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite

artworks.title: Westminster, Evening
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape at night, featuring an illuminated bridge and silhouetted buildings against the night sky. The brushstrokes are soft and diffused, creating a misty effect. The color palette includes black, gray, and soft glowing lights reflecting off the water. A prominent dark building is on the right, and the bridge arches over the water with reflections of lights.

artworks.title: Le Puy
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated viewpoint overlooking a vast landscape. A rocky outcrop with buildings stands in the foreground, surrounded by hilly terrain, winding paths, and clusters of trees. A river flows through the scene towards a distant city with a cathedral and a hill. On top of the hill, there is a glowing structure emitting rays of light. Mountains can be seen at the horizon. The artwork features detailed linework in a monochromatic style, emphasizing light and shadow contrasts.

artworks.title: London Night, Whiskey and Tea
artworks.description: The image shows a nighttime cityscape across a river. Urban buildings with dim lights line the horizon, with a tall, bright structure dominating the right side. A bridge with small lights runs over the water, creating a curve that reflects the lights. The scene has a soft, hazy atmosphere with a dark color palette, occasional bright spots from artificial lights, and silhouetted trees by the riverbank.

artworks.title: Down and Up the Hills to the Bay, San Francisco
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with buildings lining a steep street. In the background, low hills meet water. The sky has clouds. The artwork appears to be an etching with fine lines. It is monochrome with shades of black and gray. Figures are seen on the street and in the distance, water and hills can be observed.

artworks.title: Brasserie, Au Lion Rouge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor café scene in front of a building. The image depicts several tables and chairs arranged outside a café or brasserie, adorned with floral elements. The building's exterior has elaborate architectural detailing, including signage that reads "LION ROUGE" and "BRASSERIE UM". Figures are seated at tables, engaged in conversation or relaxing, creating a lively atmosphere. The shading and line work are intricate, adding movement to the scene. The drawing includes decorative architectural elements on the right side, suggesting grandeur. It captures the social life of a café in a detailed manner.

artworks.title: The Square, Independence Square, Philadelphia
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a building featuring a clock tower. Tall trees frame the structure, under a sky with obscured horizon. The painting style is detailed with brushstrokes creating a textured look. The color scheme is monochromatic in browns and sepia tones, giving an aged feel. Figures and steps add depth to the composition, guiding the viewer's gaze towards the distant building. The setting appears as a nostalgic urban scene with natural surroundings.

artworks.title: New York Stock Exchange
artworks.description: The illustration displays a street scene in a city with grand architecture. The viewpoint is from ground level, showcasing tall, ornate building facades stretching toward a central vanishing point on the horizon. The sky peeks through the gaps between buildings. The artwork is created with fine lines, pencil or charcoal strokes, and has a monochromatic color scheme of black, white, and gray. Figures and vehicles can be seen on the street among the shadows of the buildings.

artworks.title: La Place, Beauvais
artworks.description: The image depicts a market square from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon shows old buildings and a cathedral. The style is detailed with fine lines. The color scheme is limited to shades of sepia or brown. People in the square are engaged in market activities.

artworks.title: The Transept, Beauvais
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with a large Gothic cathedral in the distance. The intricate lines of the etching capture the detailed stonework and gothic elements of the cathedral's facade. The cathedral is the focal point of the composition, with impressive spires and elaborate tracery. Buildings with shuttered windows and small signs flank the pathway towards the cathedral. People are seen walking on the cobblestone street, providing scale to the structure. The color palette is monochrome, using only black and white to emphasize textures and contrasts in the scene.

artworks.title: West Door, St. Paul's
artworks.description: The image shows a view looking through a grand archway flanked by tall, classical columns. The scene extends into the distance, with hints of an urban environment visible through the arch. The artwork features soft brushstrokes or etching lines for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia or warm grays, giving the piece an antique appearance. Near the columns, a few figures are casually dressed, providing scale. In the distance, a narrow street lined with architectural structures leads the eye further into the scene.

artworks.title: Le Stryge
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape from a high vantage point. A detailed stone gargoyle perches on a building ledge, overlooking the city. The horizon is high in the image, offering a broad view of the city below. In the distance, a tower rises among the buildings. The artist uses fine etched lines to create texture for the gargoyle and the city. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and grey. The sky has softly rendered clouds contrasting with the sharp architecture of the city.

artworks.title: Le Stryge
artworks.description: The image shows a stone gargoyle perched on a building overlooking a cityscape. The city is detailed with various architectural structures, leading up to a tall tower in the distance. The landscape also includes elevated terrain, depicted in a fine-lined etching style with a monochromatic color palette of black, gray, and white.

artworks.title: Paestum, Evening
artworks.description: A view of an ancient temple, likely a Greek or Roman structure, is depicted. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing the front and one side of the temple with columns and shadows. The horizon is low, with part of the building reaching into the sky. Fine pencil strokes create texture, and a monochromatic color palette of various gray tones conveys depth. In the distance, a smaller structure is visible, and a clear sky serves as the backdrop. Light pencil strokes suggest a pathway leading to the temple.

artworks.title: The Temple of Concord on the Wall, Girgenti
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient temple on a hill, viewed from below. The temple dominates the upper part of the scene with classical columns lining the ridge. The painting style includes expressive brushstrokes creating contrasts of light and shadow in a lithographic style. The color scheme is monochromatic with gray and black tones. The foreground has rough terrain with sporadic vegetation and a tree on the left. The temple stands out against the sky. The image combines a natural landscape with ancient architecture.

artworks.title: The Temple by the Sea, Temple of Concord, Girgenti
artworks.description: The image features a grayscale drawing of an ancient temple viewed from a frontal perspective, slightly off-center to the right. The temple is depicted as dominating the composition, standing on a slight rise with rugged terrain and stone debris in the foreground. The brushstrokes are detailed and textured, emphasizing the tactile quality of the stone structure and landscape. In the background, mountains can be seen, and the color palette consists of varying shades of grey and black, creating contrast between the temple's intricate shading and the lighter sky.

artworks.title: Sunrise Behind Temple of Concord, Girgenti
artworks.description: The image features an ancient temple captured from a low vantage point, highlighting its towering columns. The temple dominates the composition, obscuring most of the horizon. The artwork utilizes sketch-like brushstrokes with dark shading and lighter textured areas. The color scheme is monochrome, with various shades of black and grey. A path leading to the temple is illuminated, contrasting with the darker surroundings. Subtly shaded foliage in the background adds depth to the scene without excessive detail.

artworks.title: Hallway to Bed Room, Stenton
artworks.description: The image features a doorway leading into a room, a dresser on the right, and a mirror above the dresser showing a partial reflection of the room. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of gray, black, and white. Positioned centrally, the doorway opens to reveal a bed with patterned linens visible in the background and further accentuated by curtain patterns. To the right of the doorway, the dresser spans vertically with a mirror perched above, reflecting an abstract view of the room. To the left side of the image, wall details and an additional smaller piece of furniture can be seen along the hallway leading into the room.

artworks.title: Hallway at Dr. Wister's
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior hallway with classical architecture. The hallway is depicted in black and white using pencil or charcoal, capturing details of the architectural elements such as columns, arches, and molding. The perspective draws the viewer's eye through the hallway, past the ornate doorway with columns and arch, towards a succession of open doorways and distant furniture. Shadows and light are implied through varying shading techniques, giving depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Book-Room at Dr. Wister's
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a room that resembles a cozy library or study. The room is filled with floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with books, and there is a door or opening to another space with more bookshelves. To the left, a table or desk is visible, stacked with books and writing materials, including a vase with flowers. On the wall, there are framed artworks or photographs, and a large globe sits on a shelf. The drawing conveys a scholarly or intellectual ambiance, with detailed line work suggesting depth.
